positive_theorem: Every finite boundary/source Green matrix for the free logarithmic resolvent is positive semidefinite; its determinant is a Cauchy-Schwarz defect.
Euler_identity: The oriented cross entry equals plus or minus (1/(2y))sum_{n<=N}Lambda(n)n^{-1/2-y} with exact prime-power support.
diagonal_no_go: The source diagonal contains (1/(2y))sum_n Lambda(n)^2/n, whose prime subseries diverges, so the raw infinite positive Weyl matrix does not exist.
renormalization_constraint: Gamma/endpoint cancellation must occur at the indefinite form level before taking a positive quotient; arbitrary scalar subtraction need not preserve positivity.
open_target: Construct a relative prime-gamma Krein Weyl matrix retaining the exact Euler cross entry and possessing a positive completed quotient.
status: first finite coupled positivity theorem with exact Euler cross term; infinite relative completion open
